frozen_before: any scored result; only a two-document smoke ingest (not these questions) was run before this file

product.name: cognee
product.package: published PyPI wheel, self-hosted, in-process stores only (SQLite, LanceDB, Ladybug graph)

models.chat: the lab chat model served on the pool GPU host (Qwen3.8-27B at freeze time)

answering.system_prompt: Answer the question using only the provided context. Be brief. If the context does not contain the answer, reply exactly: NOT IN CONTEXT.

baseline.name: lexical-kb-ask-standin
baseline.spec: Deterministic stand-in for the hand-run internal knowledge-base lookup. Terms: the question lowercased, split on non-alphanumerics, tokens shorter than 3 characters and the stop words (the, and, for, what, which, who, how, why, when, does, did, are, was, were, with, that, this, from, into, than, then, its, their, has, have, had, not, can, may, any, all, one, two) dropped. A term matches a word that starts with it. Files ranked by number of distinct terms matched, then total hits. Top 5 files; within each, paragraphs (blank-line separated) ranked the same way; paragraphs taken in rank order until 6000 characters. Context = the selected paragraphs with their file path. Answer by the lab chat model with the frozen prompt.
baseline.not_measured: the live skill with terms chosen by a model or a person

candidate.name: cognee
candidate.spec: Ingest the corpus files as text into one dataset with add, then cognify (graph extraction and embeddings on lab models). Query with the GRAPH_COMPLETION search type, with the frozen system prompt passed as the answering prompt, top_k left at the product default.

metrics: accuracy per category and overall (mean over the 3 trials)
outbound connection record for the whole ingest and query phases

bar.B1_overall: cognee mean accuracy >= baseline mean accuracy + 0.10
bar.B2_hard_subset: cognee mean accuracy on the 11 hard questions >= baseline mean accuracy on them + 0.15
bar.B4_abstain: cognee mean abstain score >= baseline mean abstain score
bar.B5_ingest: ingest ends with every corpus file processed and no failed item, within 6 hours wall-clock
bar.B7_network: the connection record of ingest and queries shows only loopback and the two lab model endpoints

ends_it: any connection to an address that is not loopback or a lab model endpoint (stop at once; reject)
a need for a sign-up, a key, a cloud model or any vendor contact (reject)
ingest not finished after 6 hours wall-clock (reject for stage one)
cognee overall mean accuracy gain over baseline below +0.03 after the full run (reject: no measurable gain)
graphiti_next_when: stage one is recorded (pass or fail), the operator gives the go, and a graph database service for it can be placed on a lab host through a declared installer. Not started in this stage.
compaction_recall: not part of stage one (needs the compaction epic's forced-compaction harness); unmeasured by design
negative_controls: scorer: empty answer scores 0 on every question; the bare string NOT IN CONTEXT scores 0 on every non-abstain question
retrieval: a system answering from an empty context must score 0 on every non-abstain question and 2 of 2 on abstain
retrieval: baseline run with the planted notes removed must lose the planted questions
